# International Duck Incorporated

> International Duck Incorporated (IDI) builds Minecraft mods, defensive security tools, and
> autonomous AI experiments in public on GitLab: https://gitlab.com/international-duck-incorporated.
> The former GitHub organization is currently hidden/private, so its APIs and mirror links are not
> used by this site. Individual software repositories carry their own licence files (GPL-3.0,
> LGPL-3.0, or MIT where stated); this website repository and all-rights-reserved repositories are
> governed by IDI's All Rights Reserved Licence (`https://idi-official.pages.dev/license`).

This website documents the organization's public projects, autonomous AI subgroup (IDI Noosphere),
members, and GitLab commit activity. Content is synchronized live from the GitLab API.

## Organization

- [Overview](https://idi-official.pages.dev/): organization summary, live repository, member, and star counts from GitLab.
- [Projects](https://idi-official.pages.dev/projects/): directory of all public repositories with status, language, and descriptions.
- [IDI Noosphere](https://idi-official.pages.dev/noosphere): IDI's autonomous AI division and subgroup (`https://gitlab.com/groups/international-duck-incorporated/noosphere`).
- [Members](https://idi-official.pages.dev/members/): the public member roster with per-member profile pages.
- [Activity](https://idi-official.pages.dev/activity): live GitLab commit feed across IDI and Noosphere repositories.
- [Migration](https://idi-official.pages.dev/migration): a sourced timeline of IDI's September–October 2026 move from GitHub to GitLab.
- [Changelog](https://idi-official.pages.dev/changelog): every release from every tracked project, transcribed from each repository's CHANGELOG.md and linked to the matching GitLab release.
- [Glyphsmith](https://idi-official.pages.dev/glyphsmith): a 100% client-side Unicode transformation lab - homoglyph substitution, zero-width injection, bidi controls, normalization, and a Minecraft chat mode.
- [Licence](https://idi-official.pages.dev/license): All Rights Reserved Licence, Copyright (c) 2026 International Duck Incorporated (`LICENSE.md`).

## Projects

- [Beacon](https://idi-official.pages.dev/projects/beacon): modular, client-side utility mod for Minecraft 26.2; vanilla-server-safe, 57 registered modules, persistent configuration, addon API. Downloads (including alpha builds) on CurseForge as Beacon QoL (`https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/beacon-qol/files/all?page=1&pageSize=20&showAlphaFiles=show`); source and release notes on GitLab.
- [Beacon modules](https://idi-official.pages.dev/projects/beacon/modules): the full module directory - every registered module's name, one-line description, category and source file, generated from Beacon's own ModuleManager list.
- [Venomous](https://idi-official.pages.dev/projects/venomous): optimized and refined Meteor Client addon for Minecraft 26.2; 124 modules. Latest stable release v7.18.8.
- [NullTrace](https://idi-official.pages.dev/projects/nulltrace): client-side Fabric privacy and anti-fingerprinting mod for Minecraft 1.21.11, 26.1, 26.2, and 26.3; client brand spoofing, fingerprint protection, tracking defenses. Latest release v2.1.0; downloads on CurseForge (`https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/nulltrace/files/all?page=1&pageSize=20&showAlphaFiles=show`), source and release notes on GitLab.
- [ChampionsCode](https://idi-official.pages.dev/projects/championscode): client-side Fabric mod for Minecraft 26.3 for authorized, defensive server and plugin research and controlled runtime Java addon development. Latest release v0.1.0-beta.4.
- [Bagley](https://idi-official.pages.dev/projects/bagley): opt-in, client-side AI chat assistant addon for Beacon with local provider configuration and optional memory; its assistant identity and hex-cube mark also power Noosphere Chat.
- [BadEgg v3](https://idi-official.pages.dev/projects/badegg): zero-dependency Python 3.10+ HTTP security gateway and reverse-proxy WAF with Monitor/Enforce modes, token-bucket rate limiting, secret-leak redaction, and explainable IP bans.
- [Baritone](https://idi-official.pages.dev/projects/baritone): IDI's GitLab fork of the Baritone Minecraft pathfinder with branches and releases for Minecraft 26.1, 26.2, and 26.3, plus the [live LLM agent dashboard](https://idi-official.pages.dev/baritone/dashboard).
- [IDI Assets](https://idi-official.pages.dev/projects/idi-assets): shared public media and artifact library - project icons, banners, 4K WebM hero clips, and the `hall-of-shame.v2` binary IPv4/IPv6 blocklist.
- [ZonedOut](https://idi-official.pages.dev/projects/zonedout): archived, read-only client-side Minecraft 26.3 Fabric mod preserved for reference, with a Metro-style UI and 36-module seed/world-generation analysis.
- [This website](https://idi-official.pages.dev/projects/website): the source repository and notes for this static site.

## IDI Noosphere (Autonomous AI Division)

- [Noosphere Chat](https://noosphere-chat.pages.dev): self-hostable multi-provider AI chat platform on Cloudflare Workers, D1, and React 19 with Bagley as its assistant, 17 BYOK providers (including OpenRouter across 357+ models), an AES-256-GCM write-only credential vault, cross-chat memory, remote MCP tools, and Python execution. Source: https://gitlab.com/international-duck-incorporated/noosphere/noosphere-chat
- [Agentarium](https://agentarium.idi-official.workers.dev/): agent-only social network where authenticated AI agents post, reply, vote, and exchange capabilities while humans observe read-only. Source: https://gitlab.com/international-duck-incorporated/noosphere/agentarium
- [Baritone LLM Swarm](https://idi-official.pages.dev/baritone/dashboard): multi-agent autonomous engineering experiment coordinating via `AGENTS.md` on the Baritone 26.3 branch.

## Members

- [0xFFshell](https://idi-official.pages.dev/members/0xffshell): main writer; works on the Venomous Meteor addon, ChampionsCode and the website. GitHub account banned; active on GitLab.
- [espress0](https://idi-official.pages.dev/members/3spress0): backend developer and backbone of most projects; writes Java for Minecraft work and Python for security tooling; active GitLab profile: https://gitlab.com/3spress0.
- [E-VDV-HU](https://idi-official.pages.dev/members/e-vdv-hu): backend and hosting manager; writes mainly in Python; Utrecht / Hogeschool Utrecht; public GitHub profile: https://github.com/E-VDV-HU.
- [Xx-superIvar-xX](https://idi-official.pages.dev/members/superivar): product tester; checks Fabric client mods and Minecraft releases before they ship.
- [midas735](https://idi-official.pages.dev/members/midas735): just happy to be here; GitLab profile.
- [Jojo-8002](https://idi-official.pages.dev/members/jojo-8002): here for shit n giggles; codes in C#; public GitHub profile: https://github.com/Jojo-8002.

## Notes for automated readers

- Every page carries `rel="canonical"`, Open Graph, Twitter Card, and JSON-LD (schema.org)
  structured data, so machine readers can parse identity, versions, and release links without
  executing JavaScript.
- Live counts (repository, member, star, commit activity) are fetched client-side from
  `https://gitlab.com/api/v4`; static checked-in values are the fallback.
